system.description:
Beginning at 2nd Level, you learn how to fight with the best of them. You gain proficiency with weapons with the Unarmed property and heavy armor. You can also make one unarmed attack as a bonus action. You may use your Wisdom in place of Dexterity when calculating Armor Class.

You also adopt a particular fighting stance. Choose one of the Taijutsu Stance located in Chapter 13: Customization Options.
